column30: No credit figure is published anywhere on the IAD master admissions page or in the official programme guide - verified by reading the full 4-page PDF, which contains no reference to 180 credits. Stated requirement: "Ce Master, organise a l'IAD, est accessible aux titulaires d'un diplome de bachelier ou d'un titre equivalent" (Master 120). The general IAD masters page adds: "La plupart des masters 60 ou 120 organises a l'IAD sont ouverts aux etudiants titulaires d'un bachelier (ou equivalent)." Two-phase selection: dossier review, then a 25-minute individual interview/audition before an artistic jury (24 Aug - 11 Sept 2026), judged on artistic and technical quality of submitted work. Portfolio must demonstrate competence in two of four options: Effets speciaux VFX, Animation 2D, Animation 3D, Developpement interactif IO. Foreign applicants: "un detail du cursus s'il s'agit d'une ecole etrangere est necessaire pour valider la candidature." As a French-Community Ecole superieure des Arts the standard 180-credit first-cycle rule of the Decree of 7 November 2013 would apply, but IAD does not state it, so no number is recorded.
